$comment: Evidence registry for the registration-readiness pilot. Every release claim points at an entry here. An entry is accepted only with a reviewer, a review date, an expiry, and a sha256 content hash of a stored artifact that exists in the repository. Entries not yet produced are draft. Validated by app/src/lib/governance/readiness-governance.test.ts. Source: pilot governance brief, 2026-10-13. Stored as JSON, not YAML, because app/ has no YAML parser and this change adds no dependency.

invalidation_rules.trigger: database migration affects referenced table or policy
integration adapter version or provider contract changes

evidence.title: Cross-tenant readiness RLS denial suite
evidence.note: Not accepted. The suite is not in the repository yet. supabase/rls-coverage.check.sql checks table-level RLS; it does not test readiness denial cases. Moves to submitted once the suite runs in staging and its artifact is stored.

evidence.title: Service-role RPC tenant binding test
evidence.note: Not run. Readiness rows are reached through SECURITY DEFINER get/save functions callable only by service_role (supabase/migrations/20261009160000_registration_readiness_store.sql), so client RLS does not isolate tenants on this path. The test must show cross-tenant reads and writes through those functions are rejected. EVD-RDY-SEC-001 covers client RLS only.

evidence.title: Stale-source freshness drill
evidence.note: Not run. Required before CTRL-SOURCE-002 can be claimed. Brief item 7 (stale-source drill).

evidence.note: Not run. Must show a requester cannot approve their own override and that the reason and decision trail are written. Brief item 7 (revocation drill covers the late-action path).
